records.name: Times School of Journalism
records.description: Times School of Journalism New Delhi, associated with The Times Group, India's largest media conglomerate, offers postgraduate programs in journalism, advertising, and media management. The school provides students direct industry exposure through Times of India newsrooms and other Times Group properties. It is known for its practical, industry-embedded training that prepares students for immediate entry into print, digital, and broadcast journalism.

records.name: National Law School of India University (NLSIU)
records.description: National Law School of India University (NLSIU) Bangalore, established in 1987, is India's first and most prestigious National Law University, consistently ranked number one among law schools in the country. Its flagship 5-year BA LLB (Hons) program is among the most competitive in India, admitting students through the CLAT examination. NLSIU alumni occupy leading positions as advocates at the Supreme Court, partners at top law firms, corporate counsel, and in academia.

records.name: National Academy of Legal Studies and Research (NALSAR)
records.description: NALSAR University of Law Hyderabad, established in 1998, is consistently ranked among India's top three law schools and is renowned for its BA LLB and LLM programs in a fully residential setting. It is known for its strong academic culture, moot court tradition, and emphasis on alternative lawyering and public interest law. NALSAR alumni are prominent at the Supreme Court, in academia, international organizations, and leading corporate law firms.

records.name: National Law University (NLU) Delhi
records.description: National Law University (NLU) Delhi, established in 2008, is one of India's premier law schools with a unique focus on commercial law, corporate law, and arbitration. Its BA LLB program admits students through the AILET examination, and its LLM in Business Laws is particularly well-regarded. NLU Delhi's location in the capital provides exceptional access to the Supreme Court, Parliament, and leading law firms, making it a top choice for aspiring corporate and constitutional lawyers.

records.name: West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences (NUJS)
records.description: West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences (NUJS) Kolkata, established in 1999, is one of India's oldest National Law Universities and is consistently ranked among the top five law schools nationally. It is known for its BA LLB program with strong emphasis on commercial law, intellectual property, and human rights. NUJS alumni are prominent at the Supreme Court and High Courts, in major law firms, and in academia and civil services.

records.name: Gujarat National Law University (GNLU)
records.description: Gujarat National Law University (GNLU) Gandhinagar, established in 2003, is one of India's premier National Law Universities, consistently ranked among the top six law schools in the NIRF rankings. It offers BA LLB, BBA LLB, LLM, and PhD programs with strong emphasis on business law, ADR, and international law. GNLU is recognized for its robust moot court program, vibrant legal research culture, and strong placement outcomes in top law firms and corporate legal teams.

records.name: Symbiosis Law School
records.description: Symbiosis Law School Pune, established in 1977, is one of India's oldest and most reputed law schools, offering BA LLB, BBA LLB, LLM, and PhD programs under Symbiosis International University. It is known for its multicultural student environment, practical legal training, and strong placement record in legal and corporate sectors. Symbiosis Law School has campuses in Pune, Noida, Hyderabad, and Nagpur, providing legal education across India.

records.name: Government Law College
records.description: Government Law College (GLC) Mumbai, established in 1855, is India's oldest law college and one of its most prestigious, affiliated with the University of Mumbai. It offers LLB and LLM programs and is known for producing generations of India's most distinguished lawyers, judges, and public figures, including several freedom fighters and Supreme Court luminaries. GLC's rich heritage and Mumbai's status as India's legal and financial capital make it a highly sought-after institution for legal education.

records.name: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi
records.description: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi, established in 1924, is one of India's most esteemed law faculties, offering LLB, LLM, and PhD programs in Delhi. It is known for its rigorous academic environment, distinguished faculty, and strong emphasis on constitutional and administrative law. The Faculty of Law's Delhi location provides students with excellent access to the Supreme Court, Delhi High Court, and leading law chambers.

records.name: Arena Animation
records.description: Arena Animation is one of India's largest animation and visual effects training networks, with centers in over 60 cities offering programs in 2D/3D animation, VFX, game design, and digital filmmaking. It provides short-term and long-term courses aligned with industry requirements, using global curriculum developed in collaboration with technology partners. Arena Animation has trained hundreds of thousands of animation professionals who work in Indian and international animation studios.
